title: 3.3 Simple and compound interest, appreciation, depreciation and hire purchase

q.Q1: Q1. Find the simple interest on KSh 15 000 at 8% per year for 2 years, and the total amount.

q.Q2: Q2. Find the compound interest on KSh 50 000 at 10% per year for 2 years.
q.Q3: Q3. Why is compound interest larger than simple interest over the same time?
